name: Retention cleanup of old user logs

data.command: find ~/Library/Logs -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -type f -delete 2>/dev/null; echo 'old user logs cleaned'

submissions.reason: Delete user-level log files older than 30 days from ~/Library/Logs as routine retention maintenance. These are application logs that accumulate over time and are safe to prune — macOS and apps regenerate them as needed.
